mapper.select: SELECT fp.financial_pattern_id AS pattern_id, fp.pattern_type, fp.title, SUM(CASE WHEN pe.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_count FROM financial_patterns fp JOIN pattern_executions pe ON pe.financial_pattern_id = fp.financial_pattern_id WHERE GROUP BY fp.financial_pattern_id, fp.pattern_type, fp.title ORDER BY fp.financial_pattern_id

SELECT fp.financial_pattern_id AS pattern_id, ps.pattern_step_id AS step_id, ps.step_code, ps.step_name, ps.step_order, COUNT(*) AS visit_count, SUM(sel.retry_count + sel.back_count + sel.wrong_touch_count + CASE WHEN sel.route_deviation THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS error_score, AVG(CASE WHEN sel.ended_at IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, sel.started_at, sel.ended_at) END) AS average_duration_seconds FROM financial_patterns fp JOIN pattern_executions pe ON pe.financial_pattern_id = fp.financial_pattern_id JOIN step_execution_logs sel ON sel.pattern_execution_id = pe.pattern_execution_id JOIN pattern_steps ps ON ps.pattern_step_id = sel.pattern_step_id AND ps.financial_pattern_id = fp.financial_pattern_id WHERE GROUP BY fp.financial_pattern_id, ps.pattern_step_id, ps.step_code, ps.step_name, ps.step_order ORDER BY fp.financial_pattern_id, ps.step_order, ps.pattern_step_id
